extracted_dmrs_evidence.dmrs_q_item: ITEM 69: When confronting emotionally charged topics, the subject tends not to address concerns directly and fully but wanders off to tangentially related topics that are emotionally easier for the subject to discuss or prefers to pay attention to someone else dealing with a similar situation. This can include preferring to read or watch a film portraying people dealing with similar problems.
extracted_dmrs_evidence.match_justification: The Supporter asks an emotionally charged question about whether the Seeker wants to reach out to their angry acquaintances for help with a job search. Instead of answering this difficult question, the Seeker deflects and prefers to pay attention to the Supporter, focusing on the Supporter's previously mentioned anxiety about potentially losing their own job.

extracted_dmrs_evidence.dmrs_q_item: ITEM 149: When the subject brings up a problem to discuss, others try to address the problem, but in response the subject skips to a different problem, thereby dismissing rather than engaging others in any suggestions offered.
extracted_dmrs_evidence.match_justification: The Supporter actively tries to address the Seeker's unemployment problem by offering a concrete suggestion ('Have they tried to help you with the job search? Do you want to reach out to them for that?'). The Seeker completely ignores this suggestion, dismissing the offered help by skipping to a different topic entirely—advising the Supporter on their own job retention.

extracted_dmrs_evidence.dmrs_q_item: ITEM 11: The subject helps others who are experiencing a problem they cannot adequately deal with alone. The problem appears to have a personal meaning to the subject related to similar experiences in the subject's past (e.g., 'It made me feel good to help someone in the same position that I once found so difficult'.).
extracted_dmrs_evidence.match_justification: The Seeker attempts to protect and advise the Supporter ('try to stay in your job whatever may happen'). This advice is directly rooted in the Seeker's own recent, traumatic experience of being laid off, demonstrating an attempt to channel their own painful experience into helping someone else avoid the same fate.
